note: Dungeons this server offers. 'type' = client terrain (name and tier come from the game's Texts/dungeons table); 'map' = file in the maps folder (without .json): change it to use another version of the dungeon. 'enabled' turns it on/off; 'opensAt' (optional, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm", local time) only opens from that date on; 'inNexus' puts its carrier in the Nexus; 'healthMultiplier' changes the health of all its enemies (difficulty). The file is reloaded when it changes (new connections). Full explanation in maps\README-dungeons.md.

nexusPortals.note: First carrier at (u, v) of the Nexus map; the others follow every 'step'. It stays outside the city, on the lower side (negative v).
